source_family: Auction House London first-party 29-30 July 2026 current auction listing, first 60 active rows after Lot 167
accuracy_guards: current auction listing snapshot is not an individual lot detail page
guide price is not sale price and may change before auction
vacant wording is preserved only where explicitly stated
occupancy is not inferred when not stated
periodic tenancy student tenancy part let ground rent and current holiday letting are not ordinary vacant possession
offered with vacant possession and currently let holiday use are both preserved without collapsing the distinction
retirement restrictions lease terms income title and reversion scope require legal pack review
room count is not bedroom count and a unit label does not establish lawful residential use
former church former Salvation Army land garages parking beach and roadways are not existing standard dwellings
development potential is not planning permission
all flats sold off on long leases does not mean the freehold building is vacant
future ground rent is not current income
adjacent lots 185 and 186 remain separate research interests after duplicate and related-interest review
